lines.hook: Where's my request? Who has it? And how long has it been sitting there?
lines.title: Meet the Ticket Dashboard, with escalation built in.
lines.req: Everyone sees every ticket at a glance. Whose move it is, and exactly how long it's been waiting.
lines.esc1: Stuck? Hit Escalate, add a note, and send.
lines.esc2: Over in the help desk, the agent and the team lead are tagged right on the ticket. It's flagged as escalated, and they get an email.
lines.queue: Agents get a queue sorted by urgency. Escalations stay pinned to the top, until they're cleared.
lines.team: Team leads see the whole team. What's overdue, what's unassigned, and who's carrying the load. And they set the thresholds.
lines.outro: The Ticket Dashboard. Live now in Product.
